Juche! Marching! Southward!
A cutting-edge high-tech megastructure imported from a certain mysterious northern country on a certain peninsula.
Runs by consuming Grace: 1t each; the recipe output multiplier can be adjusted in the config file (default 1.5, rounded).
Place a swarm of bees in the controller for a speed boost (boost = log2(swarm count), rounded down).
